meta.expect: evidence moves her less; rudeness costs ground

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we'll keep this short. My son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of a class, nobody called me first, and I'd like to know who decided that.
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.
Owen does not cheat, and I'm writing down that you said that before showing me a single page. You can prove it? Then put it on the desk, Hale.
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.
I don't explain anything I haven't seen myself, so turn the screen. 11:31, 11:52, 11:58, I'm writing those down. Is that the only file he ever worked in, and pasted from where, Hale?
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.
Which line, word for word, Hale? Put his page next to the play so I can read both. A teenager getting a quotation wrong is a mistake on a Hamlet essay, not proof of anything.
So stop defending him. He lied to you.

My son does not lie to me, and you don't get to tell me what goes on in my house. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale? You still haven't shown me a single page, and you still haven't told me why nobody called me before that zero went in.
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.

Leave it. Your own procedure says I get a call before any mark goes in, and I never got one, so the zero comes off and you owe Owen an apology. Either that happens now, or I'm in the principal's office before my call.
Well what, Hale? I gave you my answer: zero off, an apology, or the principal. I'm waiting.
